objects.description: [Kali365](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9044) has obtained OAuth access and refresh tokens by deceiving victims into completing actor-initiated device authorization requests, and intercepting authentication sessions with legitimate identity providers through adversary-in-the-middle reverse proxy infrastructure.
